name: Kagome Shoutarou
source: Main character of the first route. A normal citizen who longs for justice. Quite powerful and will listen to any kind of consultation until the end. His face does not show a lot of expression and he thinks with his heart. His dream is to become an actor and a hero who gives hope to children.
